name: codex-realtime-voice
responsibility: The public MIT voice agent: one host entry for a server and one browser client, over Codex sessions, a coordinator, checkout workhorses and the host's own identity and policy
description: Its npm build bundles codex-app-server, process, timing and diagnostics, which are MIT like it; every other workspace package is BUSL and stays out of it. Archboard and the example reach it only through the entries an outside host uses. TASK-653.11: the wire identity context lives in the shared browser area (shared/browser/schemas/wire-identity.ts), and createCodexBrowserModel() with no argument uses it, so browser-side code and the voice, workbench and example ui tests build and brand identities through the browser's own model; the explicit-context overload stays. Its packed declarations lose CodexTransport's replaceIdentity and respell SessionResponsePayloads, which the migration table records (owner decision 22). TASK-653.12 (ADR 0090): four entries, ten runtime names. ./server: createVoiceAgent, parseTabSessionId, composeRoleInstructions, createTextUserInput, additionalContextPolicy. ./browser: mountVoice, createVoiceClient, createSocketConversation. ./react: useVoiceState. ./contract: createCodexBrowserModel with the contract types. ./controllers, ./runtime, ./schemas and ./realtime are gone, and no source imports ws. The wait graph, the timeline projection, the speaking predicate and the JSON parse helper moved to workbench.
